extracted.intended_audience: general news readers and professionals interested in PR ethics and South African politics
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating the ethical standards and conduct of public relations campaigns and firms, particularly regarding exploitation of racial tensions, transparency, and compliance with industry codes. Focuses on actions (fake accounts, editing public information), client selection, and leadership accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid campaigns that "likely inflame racial discord"
rubrics_metrics.description: PR work must not be designed in ways that would 'likely inflame racial discord' or exploit existing racial tensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PRCA investigation found Bell Pottinger's work for Oakbay Capital portrayed opponents as agents of 'white monopoly capital' and used messaging that gained traction and sparked protests; campaigns that intentionally exploit racial divisions can escalate into public disorder and severe reputational damage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with PRCA code of conduct and professional charter
rubrics_metrics.description: PR activities must comply with the industry code of conduct and professional charter; breaches are actionable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bell Pottinger's work was found in breach of four clauses of PRCA’s code, leading to expulsion by the trade body for at least five years — demonstrating that non‑compliance can lead to the harshest professional sanctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid unethical and offensive behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: PR firms and staff must not engage in behavior that is unethical or offensively targeted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The company apologized and dismissed/suspended staff for 'unethical and offensive behavior' — firms should investigate, discipline, and publicly address such conduct to mitigate harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: No creation or use of fake social media accounts (astroturfing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Campaigns must not orchestrate or rely on fake social media accounts to post messaging or manipulate public debate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A campaign where 'hundreds of fake Twitter accounts posted racial messages' was linked to the firm; use of inauthentic accounts undermines credibility and can be grounds for industry expulsion and client loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not deceptively manipulate public information (e.g., editing Wikipedia)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firms should not surreptitiously edit public information sources or otherwise manipulate publicly accessible records to shape narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leaked emails alleged Bell Pottinger edited the Gupta family's Wikipedia page as part of reputation management; deceptive edits or hidden manipulations damage trust and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid representing clients linked to corruption or malign political influence without due diligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies should exercise caution taking on clients connected to corruption or undue political influence, as association carries reputational and ethical risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Gupta family's alleged close ties to President Zuma and various corruption scandals meant the account posed high risk; firms must evaluate client backgrounds and potential harms before engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership accountability and adequate oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm leadership must provide oversight, accept accountability for misconduct, and take corrective actions when staff mislead leadership or breach standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Following the scandal, Bell Pottinger's CEO resigned after an independent review and saying he had been misled; strong governance, independent reviews, and leadership changes are appropriate remedies when oversight fails.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect the profession's reputation — do not bring the industry into disrepute
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual agency actions should not damage the reputation of the PR and communications industry as a whole.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRCA stated Bell Pottinger 'has brought the PR and communications industry into disrepute' and imposed unprecedented sanctions; firms must consider industry-wide consequences of their conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refrain from amplifying divisive slogans that target demographic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Campaigns should not promote or amplify slogans or narratives that single out demographic groups in a way that inflames social divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The slogan 'white monopoly capital' was promoted in media and used to target political opponents, contributing to social friction; messaging strategies must be evaluated for their potential to harm social cohesion.
